caption: The switch is only the authenticator: it relays EAP to RADIUS and keeps port Fa0/10 shut to normal data. When Access-Accept returns Tunnel-Private-Group-ID = 20, the port opens into VLAN 20, so before that moment normal traffic on Fa0/10 uses 0 VLANs.

spec.aria: The supplicant alice sends EAPOL-Start, the switch Fa0/10 asks for identity, alice answers, the switch relays an Access-Request to RADIUS, RADIUS returns Access-Accept with Tunnel-Private-Group-ID equal to 20, and the switch opens the port into VLAN 20.
